1646-apps/nexus/src/pages/inventory/audi.blocker: Multi-step form-sheet component driving two distinct user flows (Create Audit / Create-Edit Schedule) with no existing test scaffolding; Nexus has no e2e/Playwright CI hook to fall back on, and meaningful unit coverage at this scale is out of proportion for one one-gap-one-PR candidate. 1583-analytics-semantic-view-description.blocker: On inspection, every changed line across all 3 files is Zod .describe()/doc-comment prose only — no FE-side logic or hardcoded view-name allowlist exists to assert against. The actual acceptance of sv_applied_discount as a valid view name is validated server-side (webapi/leaflogix C# allowlist, a different repo), which this repo's Vitest suite can't exercise. Writing a test that merely re-asserts the changed prose string would be vacuous (fails the red-green-revert bar). Needs a human call: either accept as already-covered (no FE behavior changed) or file a cross-repo integration-test follow-up against webapi/leaflogix.
